# Separator

> Create a break between ideas or sections with a horizontal separator.

**Name:** `core/separator`
**Category:** design

**Block Type:** Static (saved in post content)

> Create a break between ideas or sections with a horizontal separator.

**Keywords:** `horizontal-line`, `hr`, `divider`
